# Dave Webster — "Charles House goals and fix-up" (2010)

**Status:** VERBATIM SOURCE. Do not edit, tidy, or improve.
Interpretation belongs in [2009-supply-and-goals-analysis.md](2009-supply-and-goals-analysis.md).

**Provenance:** attachment `Charles House goals and fix.docx` on an email from
`DWebs49484@aol.com`, subject **"House goals"**, sent 2010-01-01 to
`cwarloe@volt.com` and `charles.warloe@gmail.com`. The email body was empty.
Charles replied: *"Thank you sir!"* Dave replied: *"cu placere."*
Retrieved 2026-09-19 via Google Drive.

**This is not a cleaning document.** It is a hospitality and home-improvement
plan, and it is the origin of the four goals and the completion rule that the
[2023 notes](2023-07-17-dave-webster-cleanup-notes.md) carry.

Typos, page break, and the duplicated "Living room" heading are his.

> **Charles House goals and fix-up**
>
> **Goals:**
>
> I want to have a comfortable place to live and show hospitality that is neat, clean and enjoyable to be in.
>
> I want to have free horizontal spaces
>
> I want to show movies, entertain 8-10 people and if more use the cabana.
>
> I want a hotel atmosphere
>
> **Things to consider when looking at my condo.**
>
> Lighting may include track, recessed, indirect, sconces, and skylights.
>
> Artwork that is in keeping with the room and atmosphere that I am trying to create.
>
> I want to create space by: the colors I choose, textures I use, lighting, furniture, and eliminate any objects that are cluttering my space.
>
> I will find 1-3 proficient home decorators to help me to achieve my house goals. They will provide me with ideas that correlate with needs presented in this paper. I will have all measurements taken ahead of decorator's arrival. Discuss fireplace area and what can be done, and move bar or get rid of it.
>
